environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on Google Cloud Run (gen2) with --execution-environment=gen2 flag. Container rootfs mounted read-only (Cloud Run default for gen2 without volume mounts). No in-memory tmpfs or volume mounts configured. Cloud Run request timeout set to 5s (--timeout=5). Container concurrency limited to 1 (--concurrency=1). The instance has max-instances=3. CPU is only allocated during request processing (--cpu-throttling). The read-only filesystem causes the logQuery() method to silently fail (IOException caught), and the 5-second request timeout terminates any in-progress regex evaluation before catastrophic backtracking can cause meaningful denial of service. The combination of strict request timeout enforcement at the infrastructure level (Cloud Run terminates the request and recycles the instance) with limited instance count means ReDoS payloads cannot hold resources.
